Subject: ACME Renewal — final commit handoff & risk checklist

Team —

We need a short, high-confidence commit packet for ACME before I loop back with procurement. Goal: confirm renewal commit (ARR $1.2M) or surface blockers by EOD Thu 9/3 so we can decide whether to escalate pricing/exec touch.

Please update the attached tracker with the following fields by EOD Wed 9/2:
- Confirmed decision date
- Procurement gating items (SOC2, data retention, audit logs, procurement window)
- Customer health notes (CS/eng open issues that could drive churn)
- Recommended commercial make-good (credit/term) if at-risk, with rationale

Quick priorities:
1) Procurement wants confirmation on audit log retention (we currently hold 90 days by default).
2) They asked for an updated SOW and termination language (30-day vs 90-day).
3) Pricing ask: ACME asked about a 10% credit for multi-year; we should evaluate whether 5% with a one-time onboarding credit is acceptable.

I attached the latest commit tracker. Put any supporting files into the shared Drive link below. I’ll be on the 11:00 AM renewal sync tomorrow to review.

[Attachment: ACME_renewal_commit_tracker.xlsx (12KB)]

Thanks —

Ben —

Thanks for the note and the tracker. A few items we need before our internal procurement review on 2026-09-10: 
1) SOC2 Type II report (last 12 months).
2) Clear statement of audit/log retention policy and whether we can request exports older than 90 days.
3) Draft SOW and concise termination language; our legal team prefers 30-day termination but we may be flexible if other terms compensate.
4) Clarify whether any data egress fees apply for log exports.

Also attaching a short list of our asks — please review and confirm which items you can meet by EOD Mon 9/7. If we can get SOC2 and an updated SOW by then, procurement will push for full approval.

Elena/Derek —

Appreciate the clear asks. Internal update and commitments below (summary to share with your legal/procurement team):

1) SOC2: Security will provide the latest SOC2 Type II report; attaching the report link in the Drive folder. ETA: 9/7 EOD (we will deliver to your procurement mailbox).
2) Log retention/export: We can offer on-request export to a customer-owned GCS bucket covering up to 180 days of logs (no egress fees for metadata exports; full data exports may incur standard egress fees depending on volume). Markus: please confirm via reply if any rate limits apply.
3) SOW & termination: Legal has prepared a revised SOW with a 30-day termination option and a standard 60-day notice for reduced services. Draft attached to Drive.
4) Commercial: We are prepared to offer a 5% one-time renewal credit (applied on the first invoice of the renewal term) + a one-time onboarding support credit to cover the log-export handoff.

Next steps (internal): Laura, please confirm the final numbers on the tracker and update HubSpot; Monica, prepare the health note for procurement explaining the usage spike (one short paragraph). If procurement confirms on 9/10, finance will push for the order to be booked the week of 9/13.

Ben
